exposure: colour-code protocol for emergency caesarean sections (orange-code and red-code)
cohort: The study included all patients who underwent an emergency caesarean section with an orange or red code at the Rennes University Hospital between 1st January 2015 and 31st December 2021.
finding: The introduction of the colour-code protocol for emergency caesarean sections significantly increased protocol compliance but did not lead to statistically significant changes in neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The colour-code protocol for emergency caesarean sections (a specific mode of birth) did not show significant changes in neonatal outcomes.
